title: Your Birthday Too
style_prompt: modern acoustic pop love song, 91 BPM, G major, one repeating four-chord loop Em - C - G - D, one chord per bar, the same loop all the way through, reverberant plucked acoustic guitar loop up front with clean wide reverb, a nylon Spanish guitar answering with short melodic fills, warm emotional male tenor, close and breathy in the verses, aching and open in the chorus, gentle falsetto lifts, thick stacked harmonies on the chorus, strong unforgettable vocal melody that lingers sweetly on the major third, big singable chorus hook, deep pillowy sub bass, gentle electronic kick and finger-snap beat held back until the first chorus, airy pads, polished spacious production, nostalgic then soaring
negative_style: harsh synths, distorted guitars, aggressive drums, autotune artifacts, lo-fi, rap verse, key change, abrupt chord changes, EDM drop

sections.name: Intro
sections.style_notes: one plucked guitar alone, lots of space, no drums, no bass

sections.name: Hook
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the markets, and the five a.m. blue
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
sections.style_notes: whispered close vocal over the pluck only, no drums

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Five a.m., the sea at Hua Hin like glass
We'd swim out before the town woke up
A fresh fish from the market in a plastic bag
We'd eat it at the condo, and that was enough
sections.style_notes: still no drums, single intimate vocal, soft pad fades in

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: We were fire and fire, we could burn the whole night down
Then water, the calmest sea around
sections.style_notes: finger snaps enter, a harmony joins, tension rising

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the markets, and the five a.m. blue
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
'Cause it's your birthday too
It's your birthday too
sections.style_notes: full beat and deep bass drop in all at once, wide stacked harmonies

lines: Drunk at the bar at the end of our street
